first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public Historic England NHLE v02 Listed Building polygons layer-3 Exeter bbox response, with returned physical Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates and bound ListEntry/Name/Grade fields sufficient to evidence building identity/type. The official 2026 Historic England FeatureServer confirms layer 3 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer supporting GeoJSON with ListEntry, Name, Grade, CaptureScale, hyperlink and NGR fields, but the selected Exeter first-50 bbox response was not retrievable through the web channel and direct DNS resolution failed before any feature payload was read; therefore no geometry or record attributes were inferred or fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
